text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. Two important tasks in this area are image recognition, which means identifying what is in a picture, and object detection, which involves finding and locating specific objects within an image. Computer vision has many practical applications in our daily lives. For example, it is used in security systems, medical imaging, and shopping apps. One of the most exciting applications is self-driving cars. These vehicles use computer vision to detect pedestrians, other cars, and traffic signs, helping them drive safely without a human driver.
